part.text:
Implemented Handlebars template support:

- Added `handlebars` dependency.
- Supports `templates/default.hbs` and per-page frontmatter `template: article`.
- Applies matching `templates/layouts/<template>.hbs`, falling back to `layouts/default.hbs`.
- Supports `.hbs` partials in `templates/partials/`, including nested paths.
- Added `--templates <dir>` CLI option and `templatesDir` build option.
- Preserves existing built-in rendering when templates are absent.
- Added template, layout, partial, and default-template Jest coverage.
